project.name: RafenDB
project.description: mini Database Management System from scratch. Made for IF3140 Database System Sem 1 2026/2027

requireJavaVersion.message: RafenDB needs JDK 25 or newer. Point JAVA_HOME at a JDK 25 install.

requireMavenVersion.message: Maven 3.9 or newer is required. Use ./mvnw, which downloads the right version.

requirePluginVersions.message: Pin every plugin version in pluginManagement.

bannedDependencies.message: Only test-scope dependencies are allowed. RafenDB uses the JDK only.
